rationale: Adds a real Chrome capture of a gradient under a translucent border and a Catch2 test that compares the native render's border rows against it, plus a matching differential-lab manifest entry. Test fixtures and test registration only; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Chrome repeats a padding-box gradient tile into its border strip'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a border-box gradient origin and an unrepeated tile paint what Chrome painted under the border'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a header gradient wraps its first stop under its bottom border'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a padding-box gradient tile repeats under a translucent border'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a toolbar gradient wraps its first stop under its top border'
